title: Foreign ATM fees for Green Account (checking)
summary: This document explains Green Account (checking) foreign ATM withdrawal fees: a separate fee per successful cash withdrawal in a foreign currency. The fee is the greater of 3% of the U.S. dollar equivalent (at settlement) or $5.00, and the daily ATM limit is $600 total withdrawals in 24 hours.
